sourceTitle: Simple Pasta With Chicken And Baby Peas
sourceText:
Simple Pasta With Chicken And Baby Peas
By: Gluten Free Recipes
Published: Friday, September 5, 2014 - 2:32am

Ingredients




4 boneless, skinless organic chicken breast halves, cut to small bite size pieces
2 slices of low sodium bacon, cut to small pieces
1/2 sweet organic onion, finely chopped
1 tsp. organic GF dried oregano
2 cups frozen organic baby peas
1 cup of organic cream
1 cup GF organic chicken broth
16 oz. cooked GF pasta of your choice, (I used spaghettini in this recipe)
1 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
Sea salt and organic GF freshly ground black pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Add chicken to a large saute pan with bacon, onion and garlic, cook until chicken is slightly brown 2 Stir in parsley and oregano and cook for 2 more minutes on medium heat 3 Add cream, chicken broth and peas and cook for 10 minutes 4 Add pasta and Parmesan cheese, gently stir with the sauce and cook for aproximately 3 - 5 minutes or until sauce thickens. 5 Garnish with freshly chopped organic parsley

About

Making a healthy and hearty meal that your family will love but have only few minutes? This pasta recipe with organic chicken and baby peas is quick, delicious and also budget friendly. It takes 30 minutes in total including prep time and the gentle flavours of chicken, baby peas and spices infuse the pasta to an amazingly delicious flavour.
